editor.skill_help.parameter_help.text_7: This is the native numerical operation parameter. Exact formula, 0 value handling and rounding are yet to be verified by current type, cannot guess by "multiple" tag.
editor.original_blocks.supplement.item_1: Value Based on Drawn Card Cost

Read the native cost of the card identified by DrawnCardId in the event context. Divide by Divider and truncate toward zero to get the multiplier for effects in the same skill group. A real draw event is required. The component does not draw cards or buff them. Divider must be at least 1 for new input. Existing native 0 is kept and treated as 1.

The second skill group of original card 551 uses DrawCardTrigger + BuffEffectDescriptor. CalculateDrawnCardCost at 0x21DC448 uses EffectData.DrawnCardId(6) and SunCostCalculator. Shared division at 0x21DBBCC–0x21DBBF0.
editor.skill_help.block.drawn_card_cost_: It does not read the fixed cost of the card the author is editing; cost calculation and Divider boundaries are determined by native static evidence, game effects are verified separately.
Used with corresponding draw/creation trigger and effect context.
Reads the cost of the card drawn by the trigger effect, used for dynamic value calculation.
editor.original_blocks.supplement.item_2: Compare EffectValue from the current event's EffectData against ValueAmount using the selected comparison. The native default for a missing event value is 0. This checks the event value, and the event must supply the chosen key. Original card 123 checks TotalBuffAmount of at least 1 in BuffTrigger.

First ability group on vanilla card 123. EffectValueConditionEvaluator.Evaluate 0x21D5ACC calls EffectData.GetValue(key,0) on the current effect and ComparisonUtils.CompareValue 0x225539C. EffectValue enum values are 0–11, with Equal/LE/GE comparisons.
editor.skill_help.block.effect_value_con: Reads the value of this effect, not permanently adding a field to the card. Comparison operations and default values are based on the current native contract.
Condition component in the ability group.
Compare the numerical value in the current effect context with the specified value.
editor.skill_help.parameter_help.text_21: The current effect value key to read; the original example TotalBuffAmount is used to check the amount of this effect's buff, not a permanent card field.
block.EffectValueDescriptor.title: 🔴 Effect: Value mapping
editor.effect_value_map.checked.error: Effect value mapping requires a native dictionary
editor.effect_value_map.checked.error_2: Special mappings must be preserved in full: {0}
editor.effect_value_map.checked.error_3: Only the two verified original value mappings are available
editor.effect_value_map.preset.error_2: This entry already has a special mapping. Presets cannot replace it. The original is preserved.
editor.effect_value_map.read.error: This node is not an effect value mapping
editor.effect_value_map.read.error_2: The native mapping data is not an object. The original is preserved.
editor.effect_value_map.read.error_3: The existing DestToSourceMap is not a dictionary and cannot be edited. The original is preserved.
editor.effect_value_map.remove.error: Only recognized original value mappings can be removed. Special entries are preserved.
editor.effect_value_map.supplement.entry: Scale the target effect's base value using a value from the source context. The native formula is current target value × source value. A missing key counts as 0. Dictionary keys are target effect values and entries identify source values. Match them to the damage or healing effect and the context that supplies the value.

Original cards 152/216/469 scale base healing by source damage. Card 471 scales base damage by source healing. The native field is DestToSourceMap. Static inspection of EffectValueCopier.CopyValue confirms multiplication and a default of 0. Source and target data are independent, and both mappings can coexist. Legacy MappingType is shown as read-only when the dictionary is missing. The dictionary is written only after an explicit edit, and unknown mappings are preserved. Engine behavior is pending verification.
R60 adds the verified original field and retains the upstream catalog attribution and license
editor.skill_help.block.effect_value_des: Vanilla 152/216/469 scales healing with damage value; 471 scales damage with healing value.

Native relationship is target native value × source value, missing key defaults to 0; source context and target effect dictionary are independent. Check DestToSourceMap direction, cannot be interpreted as direct value replacement.
Used with actual effects, triggers, and target selection.
Scale the corresponding value of the target effect with the value of the source effect.
editor.skill_help.parameter_help.text_4: Key is the target value, value is the source value. Native calculation: target original value × source value, missing key is 0. For example HealAmount:DamageAmount makes the target healing base multiplied by the source damage value; base 1, source 3 gives 3, base 0 remains 0. Source context and target effect dictionary are independent, bidirectional relationship is not rewritten by traversal order; unknown items are still retained.
editor.skill_help.parameter_help.text_5: This is the native author representation; original field is DestToSourceMap. Saving conversion, unknown mapping and original package preservation must be verified by native field contract, cannot judge settlement only by menu text.
block.HeroHealthMultiplier.title: 🔴 Effect: Hero health multiplier
editor.skill_help.block.hero_health_mult: Original multiplier contract: find players by Faction, accumulate Health.CalculateHealth.

Not maximum health, source unit health, or single heal value. Original current health is calculated as modifiable maximum minus damage taken; cannot guarantee all effects will consume this multiplier.
Multiplier of the skill group root; consumed by effects that actually use this multiplier.
Original value is the sum of current health of selected faction players, then divided by Divider.
editor.skill_help.parameter_help.text_9: Used to find the faction players participating in the summation; life multiplier accumulates these players' current life, resource multiplier accumulates these players' SunCounter.Amount. Not modifying card faction, nor directly selecting a unit.
block.QueryMultiplier.title: 🔵 Query multiplier
editor.original_blocks.supplement.entry: Count entities that match the child Query, divide by Divider, and truncate toward zero. Use the result as the effect multiplier in the same skill group. This numeric group component cannot go in a regular Query slot. Edit the child Query in its own slot. Existing native 0 values count as 1. New entries must be at least 1.
editor.original_blocks.supplement.entry_: Original QueryMultiplier component. MultiplierCalculator.CalculateQueryValue at 0x21DBED0. Shared division at 0x21DBBCC–0x21DBBF0. R60 corrects the editor category and parameter help while preserving the native structure.
editor.skill_help.block.query_multiplier: Original 11 places, 10 card definitions; see placement gap investigation.
Divider is a numerical operation parameter, not a fixed attack or health boost; only relying on this block will not form a complete skill.
Original cards can be placed in the skill group components at the same level; other Queries do not therefore gain the permission to be placed at the same level.
Participate in effect value calculations based on the query results.
editor.skill_help.parameter_help.text_6: Native static implementation: first take the original value of the current multiplier, then divide by Divider; 0 is treated as 1, signed integer division truncates toward zero. Original value source depends on this block, not fixed add attack or add health. Game effects still need actual verification this round.
block.SunGainedMultiplier.title: 🔴 Effect: Sun gained multiplier
editor.skill_help.block.sun_gained_multi: The original CalculateSunGainedThisTurn and GetAvailableSun reading ranges have been respectively statically verified.

AmountUsed is not subtracted, so it's not the remaining spendable resources; it's also not the value of a single resource gain event. The original available resources are subtracted by another function.
The multiplier for the skill group root; the faction is selected by Faction.
Use the sum of the modifiable total value of the selected faction's player resource counter Amount as the original value, then divide by Divider.
block.TargetAttackMultiplier.title: 🔴 Effect: Attack multiplier
editor.skill_help.block.target_attack_mu: Target is not the source; read through the attack calculator, not directly read the card's base attack. No verified default 1 when the target/component is missing.
The numerical multiplier of the skill group root requires the actual effect target and attack component.
Read the current attack of the object pointed to by the current effect TargetId, then divide by Divider.
editor.original_blocks.supplement.item_1: Separate Values for Target Strength and Health

Use the target's current Strength in the Strength context and its current Health in the Health context. Use 1 otherwise. Divide the value by Divider and truncate toward zero to get the multiplier for that effect. Original card 125 combines this with +1 Strength and +1 Health to double its stats. The block alone does not double stats or apply an effect.

Original card 125 uses TurnStartTrigger + BuffEffectDescriptor. CalculateDoubledAttackOrHealthValue at 0x21DC428 dispatches by MultiplierContext(Attack=1/Health=2). Shared division at 0x21DBBCC–0x21DBBF0.
editor.skill_help.block.target_attack_or: Not a fixed double block; the original Buff(1,1) combined with this multiplier produces the corresponding result. Default context and calculation boundaries cannot be guessed by tags.
Used with effect recipes that require attack/life values.
Read the attack or current health of the target based on the effect context.
block.TargetHealthMultiplier.title: 🔴 Effect: Health multiplier
editor.skill_help.block.target_health_mu: Target is not the source, current health is not maximum health; the original call to HealthCalculator current health interface. No guarantee that any effect is supported.
The multiplier of the skill group root, needs the actual effect target and health component.
Read the current effect TargetId pointed object's current health, then divide by Divider.
